parties: Adani Energy Solutions Limited acquires 100% equity shares of Vizag Power Transmission Limited
headline: Adani Energy Solutions Limited executes share purchase agreement to acquire 100% of Vizag Power Transmission Limited
sum: Adani Energy Solutions (AESL) has executed a share purchase agreement to acquire full ownership of Vizag Power Transmission Limited, marking an expansion of the group's transmission infrastructure footprint in Andhra Pradesh's power transmission segment.
implication: The acquisition integrates a regional transmission operator into AESL's national grid, potentially triggering SEBI substantial acquisition thresholds, CCI merger review (if combined turnover exceeds ₹2,500 cr), and regulatory approval under the Electricity Act 2003 from CERC and state regulators—standard gates for intra-group or third-party transmission M&A.
detail: Adani Energy Solutions Limited has executed a share purchase agreement to acquire 100% of the equity shares in Vizag Power Transmission Limited, a regional power transmission company. The transaction was formally announced via NSE disclosure on 14 August 2026. The acquisition represents a strategic consolidation of transmission assets in the southern region and falls within AESL's infrastructure expansion mandate. No deal value was disclosed in the public announcement.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 3 & 4
framework.note: central — 25% and 50% thresholds for open offer if acquirer crosses 25% or 50% of voting shares; applies to AESL if Vizag Power is separately listed or if AESL's holding in ultimate parent crosses threshold
central — mandatory CCI merger notification if combined turnover of acquirer and target exceeds ₹2,500 crore; AESL likely above threshold
central — transmission company acquisition/merger requires approval from Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (CERC) and/or state regulator (Andhra Pradesh in this case)

framework.note: amended — CERC's procedural rules for change in ownership/control of transmission licensees; recent amendments tighten financial viability and operational continuity checks

framework.note: central — state-level gate for transfer/sale of transmission license held by Vizag Power; prior approval required before closure
applicable if share purchase is structured as a scheme of arrangement; NCLT approval may be required depending on consideration structure
